## Open

### F-520 — The rest-fs spike test read fixtures that were not committed

> _2026-10-13 · ext/rest-fs · open_

The memory cross-reference spike in ext/rest-fs added a headless test that opened the sample file
under plans/memory-prose/spike and pinned an index at plans/memory-prose/spike/index.json, but
neither fixture was ever committed and the plans folder is untracked, so the file was gone and the
test died in openTextDocument before any assertion. The test also expected document links of
memory://entry/D-538, memory://doc/... and memory://skill/..., while the implementation had moved to
links on the real file (a file URI carrying a line fragment), so restoring the fixture alone would
still have failed. The lesson: a test that reads a fixture from an untracked directory is not a
test, and an assertion on a URI scheme must be checked against what the code builds, not what the
plan said.
